name: JCET high-end advanced packaging and test plant, Lingang, Shanghai

parties.name: JCET Group
parties.note: The board approved the project on 24 June 2026 through a planned controlling subsidiary with about RMB 4 billion of registered capital and allowed talks with possible joint-venture partners; a wholly owned subsidiary with RMB 4 billion of registered capital was set up in July 2026. The subsidiary is not named.

summary: A new high-end advanced packaging and test plant that JCET plans to build in the Wanxiang Industrial Park of the Lingang New Area, Shanghai, with a total investment of RMB 7.8 billion. The board approved it in June 2026, a project subsidiary was formed in July, and in October 2026 JCET said the project was progressing steadily. It is to be built in two phases: the first, covering the building, fit-out and equipment, is planned to be finished in the second half of 2028, and the second adds equipment to expand capacity. It is a separate project from JCET's automotive packaging plant in Lingang.

location.site: Wanxiang Industrial Park, Dongfang Xingang, Lingang New Area
location.note: The filing places the plant in the Wanxiang Industrial Park of the Dongfang Xingang chip cluster in the Lingang New Area.

metrics.note: Total for both phases, subject to actual construction spending; RMB 4 billion is to come from the subsidiary's registered capital and RMB 3.8 billion from funds it raises.

milestones.note: Phase 1 covers the plant building, fit-out and equipment.

notes: When the project was announced, JCET still had to obtain the state land use rights for the site and the planning, construction and environmental approvals. No construction start was found in the sources read, so the status stays announced although the company describes the project as progressing. The automotive plant is recorded as jcet-shanghai-lingang-automotive.

review.method: Independent AI-assisted review (Claude): re-opened every cited source, checked each statement against it and searched for newer reporting.
review.changes: Added JCET's June 2026 investment filing, which places the plant in the Wanxiang Industrial Park of the Lingang New Area and sets out two phases with Phase 1 due in the second half of 2028; corrected the summary, which implied the plant was outside Lingang, and dated the announcement to the board approval.
